QuestInfo.name: [MONAD: The First Omen] The Old Woman's Cabin
QuestInfo.0: You've finally arrived at the old woman's cabin!
QuestInfo.1: Inside the empty cabin, you discover traces of the old woman, but she seems to have made a hasty exit. Just as you're making that discovery, the cabin begins to shake, and you can hear the roar and crash of monsters just outside. The window offers you a view of a stampede!
